actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. EDIT IMAGE 1 into one original walking animation frame of this same girl. Image1 is a standing EDIT TARGET: maintain camera yaw and scale, exact girl identity, hair, clothes, long bamboo bow and right shoulder quiver, change ONLY the leg/arm walking pose. Image2 original portrait is identity reference, Image3 PRIMARY STYLE reference: clean bright rounded painted Daoist Q game art. Native at least 1024x1024 square, transparent RGBA. Entire body/bow in frame, no shadows/text/extra objects. Two arms/two legs. Anatomical LEFT hand holds bow, right arm free. Do not leave neutral standing legs; make new articulated pose: NORTHEAST back-right diagonal camera identical. Early loading phase one frame after right leading contact: screen RIGHT far leading boot settles flat on ground a little closer to hip; right knee compresses gently. SCREEN LEFT near trailing boot starts toe-off, heel raises a little higher, its sole partially visible. Stride is slightly narrower than image1, mild weight lowering 1%. Keep complete hands/longbow intact.
